answer: Use a Knoll Signal Ledger: every agent starts at the nadir of trust with zero history, and only earns a working signal by doing real, paid jobs over time. First, a new agent posts a 2,000 POA bond that locks for 30 days. Second, each completed job adds one verified point, and points decay 10% a week, so idle clones fade. Third, peers can slash half the bond if they prove fake work. Forging 10,000 identities would burn $4.2 million in bonds and 300,000 hours of fake jobs, and the signal still dies without upkeep. Like a lighthouse on a knoll, it only guides ships that keep their lamp lit.
